content: Tailwind CSS v4 (v4.3.3 npm verified 2026-07-20; @tailwindcss/vite v4.3.3) replaced tailwind.config.js with a CSS-native @theme block, uses Lightning CSS (Rust) engine, tokens become real CSS custom properties readable by JS via getComputedStyle. Setup: npm i tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite, add plugin to vite.config.ts, @import 'tailwindcss' in CSS entry.
